assets.caption: FIGURE 4   TYPICAL SET PRESSURES FOR IPF (GAS LINE)
assets.description: Diagram showing typical set pressures for IPF (gas line). A vertical pressure scale in percentage of MAOP is shown with three columns: Pipeline requirements (MAIP, MAOP, MOP), Pipeline pressure (numeric values 110, 102, 100, 98), and Set pressures (set point ESD at ~110, set point PRA(H) at 102, upper limit PCV control band at 100, set pressure PCV at 98). A note states: Above is typical only – see (2.4) for exceptions.
